Package org.osgi.dmt.ddf

Interface MAP<K,V>

Type Parameters:
K - The key type. Must be a type that is convertable from/to String for the child's name.
V - The value type, can be any type mapping to a node.
All Superinterfaces:
NODE
All Known Subinterfaces:
AddableMAP<K,V>, MutableMAP<K,V>
public interface MAP<K,V> extends NODE
A Multiple represents a base node with its direct children. The child's name is used as the key. A Multiple's children have a cardinality of 0..n. The entry can be made optional by wrapping it in an Optional.
